hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then echo 'No package-lock.json yet: run npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts, then start a new session.'; exit 0; fi; if ! bash .github/kit-identity.sh >&2; then echo 'kit-identity failed: nothing was installed. Do not run npm ci. Tell the owner.'; exit 0; fi; k=node_modules/@raess/astro-kit; sums() { node -p "process.argv.slice(1).map((f) => { try { return require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync(f)).digest('hex'); } catch { return '-'; } }).join(' ')" package-lock.json "$k/docs/INDEX.md" "$k/package.json"; }; sum=$(sums) || exit 1; if [ "$sum" != "$(cat node_modules/.kit-stamp 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund >&2 || exit 1; sum=$(sums) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$sum" > node_modules/.kit-stamp; fi; link=; for p in node_modules node_modules/@raess "$k" "$k/docs" "$k/docs/INDEX.md" "$k/package.json"; do [ ! -L "$p" ] || link=1; done; if [ -n "$link" ] || [ ! -f "$k/docs/INDEX.md" ]; then echo 'The kit in node_modules is a link or has no INDEX.md file: nothing was printed. Delete node_modules, then start a new session.'; exit 0; fi; cat "$k/docs/INDEX.md"
